title: prunus sativa var. subvestita
intro: Prunus sativa var. subvestita, commonly known as wild apricot or apricot kernel, is a plant species belonging to the Rosaceae family. This plant is valued for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, making it useful in treating conditions such as fever, cough, and respiratory infections. The therapeutic actions of Prunus sativa var. subvestita include analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and expectorant properties, which help to alleviate pain, reduce inflammation, and loosen mucus, respectively. The bioactive constituents of this plant include amygdalin, a cyanogenic glycoside, as well as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
